name: Senior Recruiter Award (full-size medal body)
size_basis: Body width 1.375 in = the standard ribbon width for this size (1 3/8 in full, 5/8 in miniature; DoDM 1348.33 as relayed by the coordination chat, not verified locally); proportions from the McChord rasters (disc = ribbon width); CAPR 39-3 gives no medal dimensions. Height is the constructed body plus suspension ring.

ribbon_ref.note: medal body only; the ribbon asset supplies the stripes and devices. ribbon_attach is where the ribbon meets the suspension loop.

source: Designed and measured from the Vanguard photograph senior-recruiter.jpeg (reference only): disc, rim, lettering, emblem, bail and ring are parametric shapes in inches, the same model as the miniature drawn at 2.2x (design/recruiter.js). Previously constructed from the McChord rasters.

fit.metric: same model as the miniature body, which is gated against the photograph (silhouette IoU, landmarks within 0.02 in, edge recall)
fit.note: Shape-built art at 2.2x, upright; ring and bail are cut open at the box top where the box cuts them.

measured.photo: senior-recruiter.jpeg (Vanguard photograph, 600 x 600 px, reference only)

frame.note: body width 0.625 in (the spec width) sets the scale; every length below is inches in the medal frame (origin = disc centre, +y down, UPRIGHT: the photograph is rotated by the measured hang angle into this frame)

measured.hang_angle_note: measured from the bail axis against the disc centre in the photograph (frame.js); the drawing hangs upright (bail and disc axis vertical)
not_measurable: the pebbled (matte) ground of the lettering band and the worn, mottled field of the big star are texture; the band is drawn as flat ground and the star field as one mid tone (the top point is darker than the other four in the photograph: drawn as a second, darker tone)
the five-point lobes of the small stars are plump and their centres are dimmer; each star is drawn as a solid star with a small dimple (hole of r 0.0038 in), nothing finer

letter A of AIR: it merges with pebbles of the ground in the photograph (one component 23 degrees wide); its centre and width (-15.8, 12.4 degrees) are estimated from the strip, not from a clean component; the P-A-T-R-O-L letters are narrower in the photograph than the skeleton font and are fitted by width

EDGE-RECALL GATE NOT MET (0.728 at 0.012 in, needs 0.80; precision 0.995): the pebbled ground of the lettering band gives the photograph's lit-metal outline hundreds of small pebble contours that no designed shape can match; recall by region: inside r 0.2 0.927, top lettering arcs 0.93 to 0.96, bottom lettering arc 0.74 (pebbles beside the letters), the two pebbled sides of the band (70 to 110 and 250 to 290 deg) 0.18; no stipple was invented to raise it
the star carries a thin inner bevel line along its edges that the photograph shows only as a blur; it is not drawn
frame.js disc fit is biased by the photograph cutting the disc bottom (see FRAME NOTE); the rim-ridge circle fit is used instead
ring: cut by the ribbon over its upper half, centre (0.020 in right of the bail axis) and radius fitted to the visible arcs only; the bail is the shared barrel with the shared shading
engraving grain, specular highlights and dark pits of the cast metal are not drawn (flat tones)
